data.gender_notes: Nathira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Given to the one who is pure and free
data.long_meaning: The Arabic name Nathira is derived from the root letters n-th-r, which mean to be pure and free from sin. In Islamic tradition, it is given to a child born to parents who have been granted a pure and sinless child. The name carries the symbolism of spiritual purity and the grace of Allah. The name Nathira carries the meaning “Given to the one who is pure and free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nathira usually hope their child will grow to embody given to the one who is pure and free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to a child born pure and free from sin
data.etymology: Nathira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Given to the one who is pure and free.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nathira total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
